title: Ultraflat real Littlewood polynomials
main_claim: For every ε∈(0,1) and all sufficiently large N there are signs ε_k∈{±1} with (1−ε)√N ≤ |Σ_{k<N} ε_k z^k| ≤ (1+ε)√N on |z|=1 (real Littlewood polynomials can be ultraflat at every large length).

issues.location: sections/waves.tex, definition of Q_h / application of Lemma stationary-phase
issues.description: Lemma 2.2 (stationary phase) needs φ smooth with φ'' nonzero on a neighbourhood of I_{a,h}. That means Q_h has to extend smoothly past J_h with Q_h''≠0, so ψ_{a,h} extends with ψ''≠0. The text only says 'with a smooth extension to a neighborhood of J_h' and does not state that the extension keeps Q''≠0. This is trivially arranged, because χ_h=σ near the endpoints and Q_h can be continued as σ²·(quadratic), but the paper leaves it implicit.
issues.evidence: 'Choose smooth real Q_h with Q_h''=χ_h^2, Q_h'(x_h^*)=0, and with a smooth extension to a neighborhood of J_h.' Lemma stationary-phase hypothesis: 'φ smooth on a neighborhood of I with φ'' nowhere zero there'.

coverage:
Read every section (intro, oscillation, rounding, balanced, waves, completion) and checked the main proof line by line:
- Quadratic and stationary-phase lemmas: completing the square, the Fresnel factor, and that the error is uniform in x.
- Oscillatory bounds lemma.
- Complex rounding lemma: dyadic bit-rounding with mass control, s_h ≤ 2^hμ, monotonicity of s·log(80n/s), and the grid-to-circle Bernstein/Cauchy step (πe/20<1).
- Spreading lemma: Parseval defect bound μ/L ≤ (4q+q²)/(2(1+q)²) ≤ 2q, and the tail via a double integration by parts.
- Construction of p_d: |p_j|≤1, the increment (1/8)∫(1−p²)², and the nonparallel structure of the frequencies.
- Box sizes and weight/ratio inequalities (balanced-weight/ratio bounds).
- Wave construction: ψ'=X and ψ''=−1/(λχ²); the sgn/8 cancellation; the coherent sum to Gχ·F(kθ_h+NvQ_h(x)) using integer k; the endpoint-curvature bound C|c_a|σ.
- Gap joining: outer slopes, middle slope ≥1/(4L), ρ-separation, the C√L bound, and conjugate symmetry at 0 and 1/2.
- Exterior tail: |V|≥cD, cancellation of the first boundary terms at the joins, and the A, A' bounds giving O(D^{-2}).
- Completion: Parseval defect and rounding error E_δ→0.
- Confirmed that the cited Lemma 3.1 (signed packing, closed arcs of length w_i/H) and Lemma 6.2 (real matrix discrepancy) in the in-repo companion paper 'Nearly-minimal-maxima-and-positive-minima-of-Littlewood-polynomials-October-5-2026' match the statements used, with no circularity.
- Did not re-verify the companion's proofs of those two lemmas.
